failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 coordinator reasoning: 'Both summary_1 and summary_2 have independently verified all components of the claim as fully accurate... there is no factual dispute or contradiction that would necessitate further investigation through a targeted query.' Query: 'No query is needed - the claim has been fully verified.' Despite this non-query, hop 3 retrieval still executed and returned 10 documents, all completely irrelevant to Westminster Abbey/Chaucer/Fecknam (longevity claims, query languages, musicians, galaxies). The coordinator failed to generate any advancing query after hop 1 already retrieved all needed evidence.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'No query is needed - the claim has been fully verified.' This is not a retrieval query at all—it is a natural-language statement of task completion rather than a structured query targeting entities or concepts. The retrieval system cannot use this form to fetch documents.

failure_modes.name: Downstream_Handoff_Failure
failure_modes.evidence: The hop 2 coordinator output ('No query is needed - the claim has been fully verified.') lacked the proper query structure required by the downstream retrieval system, yet the system still executed hop 3 retrieval, returning irrelevant documents (longevity claims, Object Query Language, Facebook Query Language, etc.) completely unrelated to Westminster Abbey. The malformed handoff broke the retrieval pipeline's ability to fetch relevant evidence.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 returned 10 documents entirely irrelevant to the claim (Longevity claims, Eulalia Pérez longevity, Object Query Language, Moloko Temo, Hryhoriy Nestor, Mounir Fourar, Abell 1835 IR1916 galaxy, Clutchy Hopkins musician, Dextronaut album, Facebook Query Language). The system then included all of these in the 'FINAL OUTPUT — concatenation of all retrieved documents' without filtering or acknowledging their irrelevance to Westminster Abbey, Geoffrey Chaucer, John Fecknam, or Poets' Corner.
